Cherkasy Old Jewish cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Cherkaska oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. A 1929 Russian topographic map shows this cemetery was once considerably larger to the northeast; the section that survives today is fenced and protected, but local testimony holds that the rest was demolished within the last 60 years, and private houses now stand there. The oldest surviving tombstone dates only to the first half of the 20th century, suggesting the cemetery's actual founding may be more recent than typical for this collection, or that older graves simply did not survive.
